description: Declared Strands Policy pattern recipe + runnable example (T6, T7). CONTAINS A BLOCKING API-VERIFICATION STEP: the strands-agents public API is unverified in this worktree and must be confirmed against the installed version before any handler/example code is written. Depends on FEAT-002 (decide() must exist and be importable).
steps: BLOCKING: run `uv add --group dev strands-agents` (dev group only, never [project].dependencies). Then in a throwaway script (NOT committed) record the installed version and confirm the real public surface: the Agent constructor and how tools + a policy/handler/intervention extension point are passed; the tool decorator/callable; the base class or protocol for a custom intervention/hook including the EXACT hook method name(s), parameter signature, and event/return types; and the set of allowed intervention return actions (e.g. Proceed/Deny/Guide) and which module exports them. Then a THIN ClosedFormPolicyHandler adapter constructed with variant ('choice' or 'noul') + an injected decide function; it implements whatever hook method the installed strands-agents actually requires and maps PolicyOutcome to the installed version's allow/deny/guide action objects. Isolate ALL unverified strands surface to this thin adapter - evaluate_policy and decide do not change if the API differs. Do not import functions/ in a way that pulls AWS clients at import time (inject decide + a runtime/stub).

Create patterns/closed-form-policy/recipe.yaml (declarative metadata: name, the two variants, handler reference) and patterns/closed-form-policy/variants/choice.yaml (exam instantiation, question_type=choice) + variants/noul.yaml (situation instantiation, noul per intention).

Create patterns/closed-form-policy/README.md in French: what the Policy pattern is, the two variants, and how another builder drops the handler into their own Strands agent WITHOUT RoadGuard. Do NOT create patterns/guardrails/.

Keep this out of the production path.

Done. 22 tests pass (17 prior + 5 new in tests/test_policy_pattern.py); `uv run ruff check patterns examples tests` clean; `uv run ruff check functions` still clean; `uv run python examples/strands_agent.py` runs fully offline and prints 3 allow_deny cards.

CONFIRMED strands-agents PUBLIC API (installed version strands-agents==1.61.1; `strands.__version__` is not exposed):
- Agent: `from strands import Agent`. Policy/handlers are passed via the keyword-only `interventions=[...]` parameter on the Agent constructor (also `hooks=`, `plugins=`, `tools=`). Run a turn by calling the agent instance: `agent(prompt)` -> AgentResult.
- Tool decorator: `from strands import tool`; use as `@tool` on a function with a typed signature and docstring (name/description/inputSchema inferred; optional overrides `tool(name=..., description=..., inputSchema=...)`).
- Intervention base class: `from strands.interventions import InterventionHandler` (also re-exported as `strands.InterventionHandler`). It is an ABC requiring a `name` property. Subclasses override lifecycle methods AT CLASS LEVEL; the framework only calls overridden ones. Instance-level assignment is NOT detected.
- Hook method used here: `before_tool_call(self, event, **kwargs) -> Proceed | Deny | Guide | Confirm | Transform` (sync or async). The event is `strands.hooks.events.BeforeToolCallEvent`; read tool input from `event.tool_use['input']` (dataclass fields: selected_tool, tool_use, invocation_state, cancel_tool). Other hooks available: before_invocation, before_model_call, after_model_call, after_tool_call.
- Allowed return-action objects live in `strands.interventions` (module `strands.interventions.actions`): Proceed(reason=None), Deny(reason=''), Guide(feedback='', reason=None), Transform(apply, reason=None), Confirm(prompt='', reason=None, response=None, evaluate=...). All are frozen dataclasses. We use Proceed/Deny only.
- Model interface (for the offline example): subclass `strands.models.model.Model` and implement abstract methods stream/update_config/get_config/structured_output. `stream` is an async generator of Bedrock-style StreamEvent dicts (messageStart, contentBlockStart{start.toolUse}, contentBlockDelta{delta.toolUse.input}, contentBlockStop, messageStop{stopReason}).

ISOLATION: all strands surface is confined to patterns/closed-form-policy/handler.py's ClosedFormPolicyHandler (and the example). The neutral core evaluate_policy/PolicyOutcome imports no strands and no AWS clients (decide + runtime are injected); it reuses functions.core.circuits.present.build_response for byte-identical cards, with a local fallback if functions/ is not importable. Variant->mode map: choice->exam, noul->situation.

NOTE: strands-agents==1.61.1 pulled in a large transitive tree (accelerate, cuda-toolkit, cryptography, mcp, opentelemetry, etc.) into the dev group and uv.lock. It is dev-only ([dependency-groups].dev) and never under functions/ (no `import strands` in functions/; test_bundle_hygiene passes). patterns/closed-form-policy has a hyphen so it is not an importable package path; the example and test add it to sys.path and import `handler` directly.
